transcription.notes: No gene names printed on panels; gene not assigned. Variant labels are colour-coded by onset category (Perinatal, Early childhood, Late childhood, Asymptomatic); colour reading is unreliable and not recorded per variant. Small text; some labels (e.g. Exon 25/26 cluster, c.1504_1505dup, c.1971_1990+24del, c.2345-12_2346del) read with limited confidence.

Brain MRI images (A: axial FLAIR-type, B: axial T1-type, C: coronal T2-type) with red arrows in A (two) and C (one) pointing to white matter regions. No printed text other than panel letters; no variant nomenclature or gene names. Sequence types are visual impressions, not printed labels.

Chromatogram base-call letters above traces in panel A are small and not transcribed; a mixed-base symbol appears at variant positions in Patient 1 but is not reliably readable. Protein sequences in panel B are small; individual residues (e.g. L/F at position 6, K/M at position 18, DK/EH, Q/E) were read with moderate confidence. Red-coloured residues in panel B mark the variant/conserved positions (colour-based, caveat).

Gene shown is TBR1, not COL4A1/COL4A2. Chromatogram base-call letters above traces in panel A are small and not transcribed with confidence. Long protein sequences in panel B are small; individual residues may be misread. Highlighted residue (red) at Y553 position per caption; colour cue not relied upon.

Gene shown is CHD7, not COL4A1/COL4A2. Chromatogram base-call letters above traces are small and not transcribed. Tiny residue labels in panels E and F are illegible. Some conserved sequence characters in panel B read with moderate confidence. Mutated residue highlighted in red in panel B (colour caveat).

Labels are colour-coded (blue, red, purple); per caption blue = common, red = rare cases only, purple = rare in cases and controls. Colour assignment as perceived (caveat: unreliable): red: p.Pro1554Leu, p.Val1336Leu, p.Met1307Arg, p.Pro902Leu, p.Pro352Leu, p.Ala144Pro, c.4756-9G>A, c.4463-9C>G, c.957+6C>T, c.616-5C>T, c.145-5T>C; purple: p.Pro1569Leu, p.Thr1144Arg, p.Gln462Arg, c.4929-10C>T, c.3198+10G>A; blue: p.Gln1334His, p.Val7Leu, c.4640+7C>T, c.3877-9C>T, c.859-10T>C, c.808-7C>G, c.780+7G>A, c.234+8C>T. The 'COL4A1' label on the gene diagram is small but readable.

The gene name COL4A1 is printed once at the top left, above both panels. 'AD' and 'NC' are printed beneath the two LD plots and are recorded here as panel labels. Variants are given only as rsIDs; no HGVS nomenclature is printed. In both panels rs874203, rs874204 and rs16975492 appear in bold, while rs1373744 is not bold. The LD cells are red-shaded and their intensity appears to encode LD strength; this is colour-keyed and is not transcribed. The 1-2 cell in each panel has no printed value, which may conventionally mean a value of 100, but that is not printed and is not inferred. The caption states that the cell values are r2 x 100.

transcription.notes: Sanger chromatograms for individuals II5, III8, III9, III10. No figure label, gene name or variant nomenclature is printed in the image; 'Fig. 4' and 'c.*34G > T' in COL4A1 come only from the supplied caption, not the image. Red circles mark one position in each trace; grey shading highlights it in III8-III10. Base calls at the circled position: 'C' in II5, a gap/blank in III8-III10 (base call appears missing; sequence row reads 'G' then space then 'A A C C'). The circled peaks show overlapping green and blue traces in III8-III10 (possible heterozygosity), but reading peak colours is unreliable. Note the printed base strings show C vs A difference at neighbouring positions, which does not obviously match G>T; not interpreted.

Electron microscopy images of skin biopsy vessels; no text printed besides panel letters 'a' and 'b'. The figure label 'Fig. 5' comes from the supplied caption and is not printed in the image itself, so figure_label is left empty. Panel a shows black arrows; panel b shows a black arrow, white arrows and a white hollow arrow (meanings per caption, not printed in the image). Scale bars carry no printed value in the image; the caption gives 2 μm. No variant nomenclature present.

Pedigree chart; no variant nomenclature printed. Generation numerals are printed as Roman-style glyphs (I, II, III). Symbol fill states (per caption, not printed in image): filled black = III-8, III-9, III-10 (proband, arrow); black dot inside symbol = I-1, II-1, II-3, II-6, III-1, III-2, III-3, III-5, III-6; question marks = III-4, III-7; diagonal deceased lines on I-1, I-2, II-1, II-2, II-3, II-4, II-6, III-4. Fill/shading interpretation is visual and caption-keyed; treat with caution.

Kaplan–Meier survival (retention) curve; no variant nomenclature or gene labels. Curve steps down from 100% to roughly 90% within the first ~8 months and stays flat thereafter, with censoring tick marks along the line; exact step values are not printed.

transcription.notes: Panel a is a pedigree: generation I individuals 1 (filled circle) and 2 (open square); generation II individuals 1 (filled square, arrow marks proband), 2 (filled circle) and 3 (filled square). Genotype 'mt/wt' is printed under I-1, II-1 and II-2. No genotype is printed for I-2 or II-3. Panels b-f are brain MRI images with no text labels. Panel g shows two Sanger chromatograms, the upper with an arrow above a position near the 'G G' bases. The base sequence printed under each trace was read as 'T T A A A G G T G A C A A'; the small letters are low resolution, so this sequence is approximate. No HGVS variant nomenclature and no gene name are printed. Peak colours were not interpreted.

The figure contains imaging and histology only: axial brain MRI slices in panels a–e, a coronal contrast-enhanced MRI in panel f, and an H&E-type histology micrograph in panel g. Panel g has a scale bar but no printed value. No variant nomenclature, gene names or other text labels appear beyond the panel letters. Which patient each panel belongs to is not printed in the image; it is given only in the caption, which refers to the mother, the sister and the glioblastoma.
